title: Ex-National Assembly Chief: South Korean KRW Stablecoins Must Trade on Binance
summary: Lee Kwang-jae, the former Secretary-General of the South Korean National Assembly, says Seoul must make sure Korean won-pegged stablecoins are listed on overseas crypto exchanges like Binance and Coinbase.
